name: 32025 · Lake City, FL
findings: ZIP 32025 (Lake City) has 55 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32025 (Lake City) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
42% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32025 (Lake City) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 49% of the typical level).
